records.school_scope: Government, government-aided and unaided recognized private schools of DoE, NDMC, MCD and Delhi Cantonment Board
records.effective_period: Immediate effect until further orders; subsequent 22 January circular resumes normal physical classes for all students. Exact issuance times were not established.
records.mandatory_historical_action: Up to Class V: both physical and online classes where online mode is feasible. VI-IX and XI resume normal physical classes; X and XII continue physical classes.
records.caveat: Hybrid does not mean school closure or an automatic outdoor ban. This historical circular must not be used as today's mandate.

records.mandatory_historical_action: Normal physical classes for all students, with immediate effect; communicate the change to students, staff and parents.
records.effective_period: From issuance; later orders through 8 October 2026 not completely verified.
records.caveat: Enclosed CAQM order revokes Stage III while I and II remain. Neither this revocation nor physical classes establish today's GRAP state or outdoor air safety.
